critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified at SbMarketplacePage.js:602 — ChatSheet root now has onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} which correctly prevents click bubbling to the DetailSheet (line 200) and InboxSheet (line 528) overlay onClose handlers. Clean, minimal one-line fix.

Consider (non-blocking) extracting ChatSheet to createPortal(document.body) to decouple z-index/visual hierarchy from the parent sheet that opened it. Current fix works, but portal pattern would make future regressions of this class harder to introduce.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (from iter_262): ChatSheet root div was a child of DetailSheet/InboxSheet overlays whose outermost div had onClick={onClose} for tap-to-dismiss UX. Click events from the send button bubbled up and triggered onClose, unmounting both sheets. FIX (verified this iteration): Added onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} to ChatSheet root <div> at SbMarketplacePage.js:602. VERIFICATION: 6/6 regression scenarios pass — empty send, first msg, second msg, back nav, inbox-conv open with history, send from inbox-opened chat. Chat stays open in all cases.
